Kaveri Mercantile Bank 
 Bank Guarantee Department
 
 BG No: BG/24 Date: 19 Oct 2019
 
 To, 
 The Employer / Commissioner 
 Subject: Performance Bond - Water Treatment Works (Tender RFP-132002425) 
 
 Dear Sir / Madam, 
 At the request of M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (the Contractor), we, Kaveri Mercantile Bank, hereby irrevocably and
 unconditionally undertake to pay you, on first written demand and without demur, any sum not exceeding Rs. 0 (Rupees 0 Only) toward
 
 the Contractor's obligations under the captioned tender. 
 This guarantee remains in force up to and including 29 Apr 2022, after which it stands automatically discharged unless a claim in
 writing is received by us on or before that date. Our liability is restricted to the amount stated above. Payment instructions: IFSC
 KNBX0004417. 
 
 
 
 Authorised Signatory 
 Kaveri Mercantile Bank 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 DOC-BOND-00024 Page 1 of 1
